proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationMechanics.usageLimit
proposed_widenings.justification: Action Surge at L17 permits 2 uses per Short/Long Rest but restricts spending to once per turn. ClassFeatureActivationMechanics has no per-turn usage limit field. MasteryMechanics has MasteryUsageLimit { kind: 'once_per_turn' } but that concept is not available on class feature mechanics. A new optional field (e.g. usageLimit?: { kind: 'once_per_turn' }) on ClassFeatureActivationMechanics would capture this constraint.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Starting at level 17, you can use it twice before a rest but only once on a turn.

notes: Core mechanic encodes cleanly: activation family, free cost, grant_extra_action excluding Magic, use_count with threshold_tiers cap (1@L2 → 2@L17), short_or_long_rest reset. Typecheck passes; tracer emits valid graph. The only gap is the L17 per-turn spending constraint ('only once on a turn'), which requires a new optional usageLimit field on ClassFeatureActivationMechanics. This is a surface_widening because the missing concept is a new variant/field on an existing surface type, not a missing v4 atom.
